label: context.reference
text:
Use the connected Firecrawl Application through its bound world_mcp_firecrawl interface and current MCP catalog. Select web search, scrape, map, crawl or extraction tools from the task and the server's actual schemas. For research, search first with firecrawl_search, then scrape the chosen results with firecrawl_scrape. On a large site, run firecrawl_map before firecrawl_crawl; poll a started crawl with firecrawl_check_crawl_status.

Current capabilities are declared in mcp.operation_catalog, mcp.tool_catalog, mcp.resource_catalog, mcp.resource_templates and mcp.prompt_catalog from world_mcp_firecrawl; send requests with label mcp.operation.request. When Firecrawl was connected in Octopus, each server tool is offered as its own firecrawl.<tool> tool. The declared operations also include firecrawl.call_tool with the catalog tool name and arguments, firecrawl.read_resource, firecrawl.get_prompt and firecrawl.complete. Use firecrawl.status or firecrawl.ping when connection state is uncertain.

Inspect the returned MCP content and error status when interpreting the result. Keep the API key inside its owning interface; use returned handles and status information.
